profile.summary: K2A is an architecture and interior design firm based in San Francisco that serves the San Francisco Bay Area and California. It provides services from site investigation and needs assessment through design, construction documents and construction administration. It also does interiors work such as space planning, furniture, wayfinding and signage, and has designed K-12 school facilities.
